lines.japanese: 「どーすかねえ。分かんないすよ？　だって俺、ここに来た当初は紀奈子さんフツーに好きでしたし」
lines.english: “Who knows? When I first came here, I liked Kinako.”

lines.japanese: 「ええっ！　私ぃー！？」
lines.english: “What!? Me!?”

lines.japanese: 「や、フツーに可愛いおねーさんだなあって。カケルくんにもよく言ってたし」
lines.english: “I just thought you were this cute, approachable woman. I used to tell Kakeru that all the time.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょ……どーすんの紀奈子さん、どさくさに紛れて告ってるよあいつ！」
lines.english: “Whoa... What are you going to do, Kinako? He just snuck a confession into the conversation!”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、やだ、いきなりそんなこと言われても。だって、ひよちゃんとのこと応援するって言ったばっかりだし」
lines.english: “What? Oh, no, you can't spring this on me! I only just said I'd support you and Hiyo.”

lines.japanese: 「あのー、いちおーツッコみますけど、恋愛感情的な意味じゃないっすよ？　俺そこまで惚れっぽくないし、節操なしにあちこちで好き好き言っちゃう軽薄男でもないっすよ？」
lines.english: “Just to be clear, I didn't mean romantically. I don't fall for people that easily, and I'm not some shallow playboy who runs around declaring his love to every woman he meets.”

lines.japanese: 「あはは、だよねー？　でも正面きって言われたから、ちょっとキュン来ちゃった。ありがと」
lines.english: “Ha ha. Of course not. But hearing you say it straight to my face did make my heart skip a beat. Thank you.”

lines.japanese: 「は、はあ、いえ……」
lines.english: “Ah. Well. You're welcome...”

lines.japanese: そーゆーもん？
lines.english: Was that how it worked?

lines.japanese: な、なんかそう言われると照れるな。たしかに俺、女のひと相手に真顔で好きとか口走っちゃったのか。
lines.english: N-now that she put it that way, I was getting embarrassed. I really had looked a woman in the eye and blurted out that I liked her.

lines.japanese: うわ、痛い……は、は、は、恥ずかしい……。
lines.english: Oh God, what was wrong with me...? Th-th-this was mortifying...

lines.japanese: 「なーに赤くなってんだよ千歳」
lines.english: “Why are you turning red, Chitose?”

lines.japanese: 「アッ！　いや、違っ、これはべつに意味深な照れじゃなくっ……！」
lines.english: “Ah! No, wait! It’s not like I’m blushing because this means anything...!”

lines.japanese: 「言ーってやろー、言ってやろー。たーまひよーに言ってやろー」
lines.english: “I'm telling, I'm telling! I'm te-lling Moth-er Hen!”

lines.japanese: くっ、子供か……。
lines.english: Damn it, was she five years old...?

lines.japanese: 「やーん、私って罪な女だあ。でもごめん千歳君、ひよちゃんを悲しませることは出来ないよ」
lines.english: “Oh, what a heartbreaker I am. But I'm sorry, Chitose. I could never break Hiyo's heart.”

lines.japanese: 「や、ひよちゃん悲しみませんから。言いたくないけど、ぜんぜん悲しんでくれないと思いますから」
lines.english: “Hiyo wouldn't be heartbroken. It pains me to admit it, but I don't think she'd be heartbroken in the slightest.”

lines.japanese: 「私も忘れるから、今夜のことは誰にも言っちゃダメだよ」
lines.english: “I'll forget it too, so no one can ever know about tonight.”

lines.japanese: 「え、どれ？　今夜のことどれ？　しまぱん？」
lines.english: “Which part? What about tonight? The striped panties?”

lines.japanese: 「ひ、ひよちゃんを……大切に……してね……？」
lines.english: “P-please... take good care... of Hiyo... all right?”

lines.japanese: 「あの、情感たっぷり込めた小芝居とかいりませんから」
lines.english: “Spare me the overwrought little performance.”

lines.japanese: 「惜しかったな千歳。おまえ、もうちょっと早く動いてれば別の脈もあったじゃん」
lines.english: “Too bad, Chitose. If you'd moved a little sooner, you might've had a shot elsewhere.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、ないっすよ。見てくださいよ、あの紀奈子さんの、あからさまなおちょくり顔」
lines.english: “No chance. Look at Kinako's face—she's openly having me on.”

lines.japanese: 「どーかなー？　女は押しの強い男に弱いよー？」
lines.english: “Who knows? Women have a weakness for men who come on strong.”

lines.japanese: いちいちあー言えばこー言う形式で俺をからかい続ける先輩方に、ちょっとした反撃を企てました。
lines.english: No matter what I said, the two of them had another comeback ready. So I devised a modest counterattack of my own.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ、もし俺がデートに誘ったら、紀奈子さんはＯＫしてくれるんすか」
lines.english: “Then if I asked you on a date, Kinako, would you say yes?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、どうしようえりちゃん。千歳君がもしもを装って私にコナかけてきた」
lines.english: “Oh! What do I do, Eri? Chitose is pretending it's hypothetical while he hits on me.”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、そんなロマンチックな駆け引きじゃなく」
lines.english: “No, I'm not making some coy romantic move.”

lines.japanese: 「でも紀奈子さん、あいつ金持ってないよ。付きあって半年もしたら、どうせ毎回自宅でダラダラするだけのデートになるって」
lines.english: “But Kinako, he's broke. Give it six months and every date will be the two of you lazing around at his place.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、仮定の話でそんなリアリティを追究しなくても」
lines.english: “We don't need to work out the practical details of a hypothetical relationship.”

lines.japanese: 「ううん、べつに私、そんな大したところへ連れてってくれなくてもいいの。ふたりきりで居られれば公園でも川原でもどこでもいいの」
lines.english: “That's all right. I don't need him to take me anywhere special. As long as we're alone together, a park, a riverbank—anywhere would do.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、そうすか。じゃあふたりきりで交通量調査のアルバイトでもしましょう」
lines.english: “Oh, I see. Then let's take a traffic-counting job together, just the two of us.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、それデートじゃないよ」
lines.english: “What? That's not a date.”

lines.japanese: 「アナタ今どこでもいいって言ったでしょ。金も稼げて一石二鳥じゃないすか」
lines.english: “You just said anywhere would do. We'd make money at the same time—two birds with one stone.”

lines.japanese: 「ううっ、えりちゃあーん、千歳君が冷たいよう。私なんてどうせ二番目の女だと思って適当に扱われてるんだ」
lines.english: “Uuuugh, Eri! Chitose is being so cold. He thinks I'm only his second choice, so he treats me any old way.”

lines.japanese: 「うわ、ひっでーなあ千歳。おまえ男として最悪だ。彼女のこんな姿見て可哀想だと思わないのかよ」
lines.english: “God, Chitose, that's horrible. You're the worst kind of man. Doesn't it break your heart to see her reduced to this?”

lines.japanese: 「どこが可哀想に見えるってんすか、この白々しい演技で」
lines.english: “What about this obviously fake act is supposed to make me feel sorry for her?”

lines.japanese: 「こらー！　誰が大根役者だー！」
lines.english: “Hey! Who are you calling a ham!?”

lines.japanese: 「演技なのは否定しないんだ……」
lines.english: “So you don't deny that you're acting...”

lines.japanese: そして俺たちは、しばらく色気のない与太話を続けるのでした。
lines.english: And so we carried on with our resolutely unromantic nonsense for a while longer.
